big_picture.title: Stock Market Up, Still Suffers Stiff Weekly Loss; Inflation Data, CoreWeave Earnings Due
big_picture.excerpt: The stock market, including the Dow Jones, suffered stiff weekly losses. A new inflation reading and CoreWeave earnings now loom.
paragraphs: The stock market dug in Friday, but indexes still slumped to painful weekly losses as investors digested the Democratic Party's win in the midterm elections. A new inflation reading and more corporate earnings are due in the week ahead.

The Nasdaq composite on Friday fared best out of the major indexes as it surged 1.1%. The tech-heavy index suffered a chastening weekly decline of 3.4% though, and is now stuck below its 200-day moving average. It has seen its gain for the year shrink to 5.8%.
